{{Quote|How do, ''Out Runner'', this is Red Team, leader. Got us a non-clear here and I was wonderin' if you could give us some info on it, copy?|Red Team leader|<ref name="IC" />}}
'''Red Team leader''' was the commander of a three [[Starfighter/Legends|ship]] [[Flight group/Legends|flight]] of [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|T-65 X-wing starfighters]] known as [[Red Team (Isis)|Red Team]]. Assigned to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Isis/Legends|Isis]], Red Team was destroyed while pursuing the [[Imperial Survey Corps/Legends|Imperial Survey Corps]] [[Far*Reach IV PQR]] ''[[Wanderer]]'' over the planet.
